70601-archeology-of-the-lower-mimbres-va.title: (With Eight Plates)
70601-archeology-of-the-lower-mimbres-va.creator: J. Walter Fewkes
70601-archeology-of-the-lower-mimbres-va.description: A book by J. Walter Fewkes. This ruin was situated near the Rio Grande, twenty-three miles from Mule Spring, on the road to the Mimbres. Bartlett does not tell us how he learned that this was an early mission site, but from the pottery it is evident that it was an “ancient Indian settlement.”

arxiv-2006-01563.title: Exploring Cross-sentence Contexts for Named Entity Recognition with BERT
arxiv-2006-01563.creator: Jouni Luoma, Sampo Pyysalo
arxiv-2006-01563.description: Abstract Named entity recognition (NER) is frequently addressed as a sequence classification task with each input consisting of one sentence of text. It is nevertheless clear that useful information for NER is often found also elsewhere in text. Recent self-attention models like BERT can both capture long-distance relationships in input and represent inputs consisting of several sentences.

arxiv-2012-09487.title: Ion-acoustic rogue waves in double pair plasma having non-extensive particles Journal: “Contributions to Plasma Physics"
arxiv-2012-09487.creator: S. Jahan ∗,1 , M.N. Haque ∗∗,1 , N.A. Chowdhury ∗∗∗,2 , A. Mannan †,3 , and A.A. Mamun §,1
arxiv-2012-09487.description: Abstract The modulational instability (MI) of ion-acoustic (IA) waves (IAWs) and associated IA rogue waves (IARWs) in double pair plasma containing non-extensive electrons, iso-thermal positrons, negatively and positively charged ions have been governed by the standard nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLSE).

arxiv-2311-09968.title: Gradient Flow in Morse and Analytic Settings
arxiv-2311-09968.creator: Leyang Zhang email leyangz_hawk@outlook.com
arxiv-2311-09968.description: Abstract This report is actually the in-class project of MATH489 FA2022, Dynamics and Differential Equations in University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. The report is mainly about gradient flow of a Morse-type functions (Morse functions, Morse–Bott functions, etc.) and analytic functions. Several small results that I develop during the reading are included as well.

arxiv-2411-08007.title: Skyrme-Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov mass models on a 3D mesh: IV. Improved description of the isospin dependence of pairing Journal: Eur. Phys. J. A
arxiv-2411-08007.creator: Guilherme Grams e1,addr1,addr2, Nikolai N. Shchechilin e2,addr1,addr2, Adrian Sanchez-Fernandez addr1,addr2, Wouter Ryssens addr1,addr2, Nicolas Chamel addr1,addr2, Stephane Goriely addr1,addr2
arxiv-2411-08007.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Guilherme Grams e1,addr1,addr2, Nikolai N. Shchechilin e2,addr1,addr2, Adrian Sanchez-Fernandez addr1,addr2, Wouter Ryssens addr1,addr2, Nicolas Chamel addr1,addr2, Stephane Goriely addr1,addr2. Providing reliable data on the properties of atomic nuclei and infinite nuclear matter to astrophysical applications remains extremely challenging, especially when treating both properties coherently within the same framework. Methods based on energy density functionals (EDFs) enable manageable calculations of nuclear structure throughout the entire nuclear chart and of the properties of infinite nuclear matter across a wide range of densities and asymmetries.

arxiv-2503-03415.title: The Jordan decomposition and Kaplansky’s second test problem for Hermitian holomorphic vector bundles
arxiv-2503-03415.creator: Bingzhe Hou, Chunlan Jiang
arxiv-2503-03415.description: Abstract . In 1954, I. Kaplansky proposed three test problems for deciding the strength of structural understanding of a class of mathematical objects in his treatise "Infinite abelian groups", which can be formulated for very general mathematical systems. In this paper, we focus on Kaplansky’s second test problem in a context of complex geometry.

arxiv-2505-16846.title: Ray-tracing GR-MHD-generated outflows from AGNs hosting thin accretion disks
arxiv-2505-16846.creator: Bidisha Bandyopadhyay, Christian Fendt, Dominik R.G. Schleicher, Neil M. Nagar, Felipe Agurto-Sepúlveda, Javier Pedreros
arxiv-2505-16846.description: Abstract Context. Active galactic nuclei (AGNs) exhibit a wide range of black hole masses and inflow/outflow properties. It is now possible to probe regions close to the event horizons of nearby supermassive black holes (SMBHs) using very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) with earth-sized baselines, as performed by the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT). Aims.

arxiv-2509-00391.title: The Resurgence of GCG Adversarial Attacks on Large Language Models
arxiv-2509-00391.creator: Yuting Tan, Xuying Li, Zhuo Li, huizhen Shu, Peikang Hu
arxiv-2509-00391.description: Abstract . Gradient-based adversarial prompting, such as the Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) algorithm, has emerged as a powerful method for jailbreaking large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we present a systematic appraisal of GCG and its annealing-augmented variant, T-GCG, across open-source LLMs of varying scales. Using Qwen2.5-0.5B, LLaMA-3.

arxiv-2511-21379.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yixia Zhang, Panyue Zhou. Let 𝒜 \mathcal{A} be an additive category and let T : 𝒜 → 𝒜 T\colon\mathcal{A}\rightarrow\mathcal{A} be an additive functor equipped with a natural transformation ω : Id 𝒜 → T \omega\colon\mathrm{Id}_{\mathcal{A}}\rightarrow T . arxiv-2601-17639.title: Uniqueness and stability in bottom detection through surface measurements of water waves
arxiv-2601-17639.description: Abstract This paper investigates the geometric inverse problem of recovering the bottom shape from surface measurements of water waves. Using the general water-waves system on a bounded subdomain of the fluid domain, we address this inverse problem, focusing on the identifiability and the stability issues.

pmc-10595075.title: 5.L. Workshop: School health literacy as a means to achieve European public health goals
pmc-10595075.creator: Organised by: EUPHA-HL, EUPHA-CAPH, Technical University of Munich (Germany), Chair persons: Orkan Okan (EUPHA-HP), Sonia Saxena (EUPHA-CAPH)
pmc-10595075.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundIn recent years, health literacy has been acknowledged as crucial in context of school health promotion, prevention, and education. In 2020, the Schools for Health in Europe Network, linking the 53 WHO European Region Member States to collaborate on school health, released a milestone fact sheet on health literacy in schools, including an evidence synthesis on how health literacy impacts not only health goals but educational outcomes.

pmc-10638691.title: Role of PPAR-related genes in chronic heart failure: evidence from large populations
pmc-10638691.creator: Zun-Ping Ke, Wen-Qi Tao, Gang Zhao, Kuan Cheng
pmc-10638691.description: BackgroundThe role of PPAR signaling and its associated genes in the pathogenesis and progression of chronic heart failure (CHF) remains elusive.MethodsWe accessed the gene expression profile and relevant baseline information of CHF samples from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database, specifically from the GSE57338 project.ResultsFrom GSE57338 project, we derived the expression value of 126 PPAR-related genes.

pmc-10726826.title: Improved efficiency of daratumumab treatment of multiple myeloma adopting the subcutaneous route: A micro‐costing analysis in three Italian hematology centers
pmc-10726826.creator: Lorenzo Pradelli, Massimo Massaia, Elisabetta Todisco, Filippo Gherlinzoni, Anna Furlan, Maria La Targia, Elisabetta Grande, Ignazio Ezio Tripoli, Francesca Occhipinti, Francesco Comello, Fabrizio Iannello, Stefania Bellucci
pmc-10726826.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundDaratumumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody approved for the treatment of adult patients with newly diagnosed or relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM). Subcutaneous (SC) formulation proved to be non‐inferior in comparison with intravenous (IV) administration route.

pmc-11335135.title: Adsorption of oral antibacterial agents on zirconia surfaces with different crystal systems†
pmc-11335135.creator: Mihiro Itotagawa, Hiroshi Kono, Tadahiro Higashinakao, Yuki Sugiura, Yuta Otsuka, Masafumi Kikuchi, Yoshihiro Nishitani
pmc-11335135.description: Zirconia ceramics are widely used as dental prosthetics owing to their high biocompatibility, excellent mechanical strength, and aesthetic properties similar to color tones of natural teeth. However, there exists a growing demand for the facile attachment of antibacterial properties in long-term dental restoration.

pmc-11576019.title: Does type II diabetes mellitus increase the morbidity of patients with diverticulitis?
pmc-11576019.creator: Marei H. Alshandeer, Walid M. Abd El Maksoud, Khaled S. Abbas, Fahad S. Al Amri, Maha A. Alghamdi, Hassan A. Alzahrani, Abdullah Dalboh, Mohammed A. Bawahab, Aisha J. Asiri, Yahia Assiri
pmc-11576019.description: Diverticular disease is a common condition that has numerous complications. Understanding the impact of diabetes mellitus (DM) on these complications, especially diverticulitis, is crucial for optimizing patient care. This study aimed to determine the relationship between type II DM and the complications of colonic diverticulitis.

pmc-12550593.title: Exploring Transient Acute Respiratory Distress in Cholera: A Case Series
pmc-12550593.creator: Samuel Amo‐Tachie
pmc-12550593.description: Transient acute respiratory distress is a complication of cholera that is not fully understood, even though there are plausible theoretical explanations. Clinicians managing cholera outbreaks need to be aware of this phenomenon in order to manage it appropriately, while further studies are required for a holistic understanding and possible prevention.

pmc-13231310.title: Molecular prevalence and phylogenetic characterization of Plasmodium juxtanucleare in Thai native chickens and fighting cocks across Kalasin Province, Northeast Thailand
pmc-13231310.creator: Jiranan Insee, Sirikanda Thanasuwan
pmc-13231310.description: Background and Aim:Avian malaria caused by Plasmodium spp. is an important vector-borne disease affecting poultry production in tropical and subtropical regions. Thai native chickens (Gallus gallus domesticus) and fighting cocks represent valuable genetic and economic resources in Thailand, yet information on the molecular epidemiology of avian malaria in northeastern Thailand remains limited.

pmc-13299385.title: Perioperative immune-checkpoint inhibitors for muscle-invasive bladder cancer
pmc-13299385.creator: Albert Jang, Abby L Grier, Iris Y Sheng, Shahla Bari, Pedro C Barata, Jorge A Garcia, Jason R Brown

pmc-13434171.title: The promise of long-read RNA-seq: reducing bias in analyses of allele imbalance
pmc-13434171.creator: Nadja Nolte, Marko Petek, Pablo Angulo Lara, Logan Mulroney, Francesco Nicassio, Fabio Marroni, Lauren McIntyre
pmc-13434171.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Inaccurate allele and gene expression counts due to map bias and genome ambiguity lead to high false positive and false negative rates in studies of allelic imbalance. We demonstrate that long read RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and straightforward quality control measures can be used to reduce bias in allele counts in case studies from four species: Drosophila melanogaster, a diploid insect; Solanum tuberosum, an autopolyploid plant; Pongo abelii, a highly heterozygous diploid primate, and Homo sapiens.
